literal: Measure not-things having done right-there they-will-perish, theft not other-things those-who-do-not-know.
translation: Those who know no ways of life other than theft will commit boundless wrongs and perish right there.
modern: களவைத் தவிர வேறு நல்ல வழிகளை அறியாதவர்கள், அளவுக்கு மீறிய தீய செயல்களைச் செய்து அப்போதே அழிந்து போவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the inevitable ruin that comes to those whose only skill is stealing. The phrase 'களவு அல்ல மற்றைய தேற்றாதவர்' refers to people who do not know any honest means of living, knowing nothing but theft. Because they lack moral boundaries, they commit 'அளவு அல்ல'—acts that go beyond all acceptable limits or measures. Consequently, 'ஆங்கே வீவர்' indicates they will perish immediately or right in the midst of their boundless transgressions.
